name: MacWhisper

knownPaths.description: MacWhisper's application support folder. Most of it is the speech-recognition models it downloads, which are large; the rest is a transcript database and logs. MacWhisper is installed on this Mac, so this folder is live working data rather than residue — removing it discards your model downloads, and removing the database discards your transcripts.
MacWhisper application support, kept under its bundle identifier rather than its name.
MacWhisper cache. Rebuilt when it is next needed.

description: MacWhisper — transcribes audio to text on the Mac using Whisper models.
